SparkR / SPARKR-223
Make API documentation accessible outside of R installation
Issue Type: Improvement
Assignee: Unassigned
Created: 11/Mar/15 11:45 PM
Priority: Minor
Reporter: Felix Cheung

We have .Rd for API documentation and they get converted into HTML when the SparkR package is installed.
Is it possible to get these up on a site and available on the internet a la PySpark: http://spark.apache.org/docs/latest/api/python/

It'll be especially cool if we used knitr or something like that to get pretty HTML. (http://yihui.name/en/2012/10/build-static-html-help/ has some details)

BTW the code for the website lives in the gh-pages branch on the same repo – so you if you want to pick this up you can just send a PR to that branch.
